body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Macally(www.macally.com) unveiled new model of 'Eco Series', eco-friendly laptop stand with bamboo material at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.
'Eco Series' is made of bamboo and good eco-friendly product for everywhere such as office and house. Cooling fan at the bamboo's crack makes air circle. The release date has not yet been set.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
